job.title: Senior Architect PIM & E-Commerce Daten Prozesse (m/w/d)

tailoring.headline: Senior Architect PIM & E-Commerce Daten Prozesse | SAP Commerce Cloud Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, microservices and OCC REST APIs, with proven design and implementation of PIM-to-Commerce data pipelines, ERP/MDM integrations and API migrations. Strong techno-functional consulting experience: requirements analysis, user story creation and stakeholder coordination. Skilled in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, performance tuning and AI-assisted development. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Architect PIM & E-Commerce Daten Prozesse
cover_en.hook: I am excited by fischer group's commitment to data-driven e-commerce innovation. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have built and optimized complex PIM and e-commerce platforms that align perfectly with this role’s focus.

bullets.label: PIM Integration
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and built robust PIM-to-Hybris pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, ensuring synchronized product data across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Led end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud architecture for B2B/B2C platforms at both Rockwell and Shell, delivering headless APIs, promotions engine and order management with Java/Spring best practices.

bullets.label: API Design & Migration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST services and executed API migrations that improved system stability and data consistency for multi-regional storefronts.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Acted as a bridge between business and IT, gathering requirements, writing user stories and functional specs, and guiding international teams through agile delivery and production support.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to fischer group.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Architect PIM & E-Commerce Daten Prozesse
cover_de.hook: Die fischer group begeistert mich durch ihre Vorreiterrolle im datengetriebenen E-Commerce. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in SAP Commerce Cloud bei Rockwell Automation und Shell habe ich komplexe PIM- und E-Commerce-Plattformen aufgebaut und optimiert, die exakt zu den Anforderungen dieser Position passen.

bullets.label: PIM-Integration
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich robuste PIM-zu-Hybris-Pipelines mit Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub konzipiert und implementiert, um produktbezogene Daten global konsistent zu halten.

bullets.label: E-Commerce-Architektur
bullets.text: Ich leitete die End-to-End-Architektur von SAP Commerce Cloud für B2B- und B2C-Plattformen bei Rockwell und Shell, inklusive Headless-APIs, Promotions-Engine und Order-Management nach Java/Spring-Best-Practices.

bullets.label: API-Design & Migration
bullets.text: Ich entwickelte OCC-REST-Services und führte API-Migrationen durch, die die Systemstabilität und Datenkonsistenz für mehrregionale Storefronts verbesserten.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Führung
bullets.text: Ich fungierte als Bindeglied zwischen Business und IT, erfasste Anforderungen, erstellte User-Stories und Funktionsspezifikationen und steuerte internationale Teams durch agile Delivery und Production Support.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Aufenthaltserlaubnis, befinde mich bis zum 15.12.2026 in der Kündigungsfrist und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zur fischer group zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: fischer group stands out as a leader in creating intelligent, data-centric e-commerce ecosystems. Your focus on seamless PIM integration, scalable architecture and innovative digital experiences aligns perfectly with my background in SAP Commerce Cloud, PIM-to-Commerce pipelines and API-driven solutions. I am eager to contribute my techno-functional expertise to help fischer group accelerate its vision of next-generation commerce platforms.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join fischer group to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud and PIM integration expertise, driving innovative e-commerce architectures that match your data-centric vision.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of PIM and e-commerce integration experience. I’m very interested in the Senior Architect PIM & E-Commerce role at fischer group and would love to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Senior Architect PIM & E-Commerce Daten Prozesse
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Architect PIM & E-Commerce Daten Prozesse position at fischer group. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to bring my expertise in PIM integration and e-commerce architecture to your team. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit.
